title: First Game/Critique advice
author: Fit_Ant_8557
selftext:
Ive had this idea for a long time for a game. The idea is basically a JRPG monster collecting/battling game with horror/ SCPish monsters. This is my first attempt at creating a game with AI. As of right now its just something im doing for personal enjoyment and have no plans of monetization. Im having alot of fun with AI to create it. Its built with Gadot and as of now im just working on the mobile version(mostly because it allows me to work on it and test it at work) i want to give you guys a preview of some of the gameplay and take all the heat,critiques and advices you guys are willing to offer. Video was to large to upload the full thing so im uploading this short clip and if i get decent feedback and people want to see more ill post my snippets of features/areas/dungeons(which look awful atm) and whatever else. Please keep in mind its in the very early stages. Ive only been at it for a few weeks.

**Tools used**

AI used: Codex Astra 6-High/medium/very high reasoning for 90% of it. Recently started using Sol 6.1 High/Medium(which seems to be delivering equal quality if not better quality while being slower and with less tokens being eaten up)

Game engine: Gadot

**Issues im aware of and working on**

Sprites animations being either janky, slow, non existant or just wavy

Assets being improperly placed, having inconsistant quality, or sized badly

Pretty bad lag in multiple menus/areas

Roads and paths all over the place and either leading to nothing or just routed stupid

The weird objective marker that wont seem to go away on the overworld map

The one and only audio playing in battle(which is really annoying sounding to me now so i will be adding lots of variety) 

The overly loud rain audio and the morning being to bright and the night not dark enough

replies.body: This is the kind of response i was looking for😂 I knew it looked off but i didnt know why or what to change the orientation and look to

comments.author: Dragday
comments.body:
Take a few screenshots of your gameplay
Put it into chat gpt, and ask it to give your game some identity (add some description, and mention it should feel more like a game and less like a browser), and create an image from it.

Then with those references, try to prompt your codex to achieve
